The Human Resource Development Centre (HRDC) of APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University (KTU), Thiruvananthapuram, proposes to develop e-content in the form of recorded video sessions for the course Algorithmic Thinking with Python (Course Code: UCEST105), included in the BTech 2024 Scheme curriculum of the University. In this connection, HRDC has proposed that the University may invite an Expression of Interest (EOI) from eligible and qualified faculty members for the development of high-quality e-content aligned with the approved syllabus of the BTech 2024 Scheme. The salient details are as follows; Course Details: Course Title: Algorithmic Thinking with Python Course Code: UCEST105 Applicable Programme: BTech (2024 Scheme), KTU Content Structure: The course syllabus comprises four (4) modules. The total duration of the video content shall be limited to 20–25 hours. Each module may be divided into smaller units with individual video durations of 10–30 minutes. Long continuous video lectures exceeding 30 minutes shall be avoided. The content shall include interactive elements such as activities, quizzes, or problem- solving tasks to enhance student engagement. Recording and Hosting: Since the University does not currently have a dedicated recording studio, the selected faculty shall use their own suitable hardware and software facilities for recording, ensuring good audio-visual quality. The selected expert faculty shall also be responsible for uploading the content to the University’s Learning Management System (LMS). Eligibility Criteria: Applicants shall be faculty members from: National Institutes such as IITs, IIMs, IISERs, NITs, IISTs, IIITs , or Affiliated colleges of KTU or Teaching departments of other Universities. Educational Qualification and Experience: UG, PG, and PhD in Computer Science and Engineering / Information Technology / Electronics and Communication Engineering, or related disciplines. Minimum five (5) years of teaching experience. Desirable: Prior experience in e-content development for reputed platforms such as SWAYAM-NPTEL. Remuneration: Content Development: ₹ 40,000/- ( ₹ 10,000/- per module) Academic Review: ₹ 16,000/- ( ₹ 2,000/- per module for two subject matter experts) Plagiarism and Copyright Compliance: The selected faculty shall ensure that the content is original and free from plagiarism. Proper copyright clearance shall be obtained for any third-party materials used. Plagiarism detection tools such as URKUND or Turnitin may be used to verify originality. Proper references and credits shall be provided for all source materials. Content Review and Approval: The developed e-content shall be reviewed by two subject matter experts appointed by the University.
